purpose: Optional host check vocabulary, not default requirements or gold outcomes. Select only applicable checks and bind passed status to real current evidence/artifacts.
public_health_notes: warning_judgment and transmission_uncertainty are distinct judgement endpoints, not official-announcement-only requirements.
Rumor/hypothesis support, counterevidence and source independence are observations; rumor visibility is not confirmation.
Deletion, silence or a denial alone cannot establish that risk is ruled out.
